title: Southern Comfort Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Southern Comfort is a 6.00 bedroom, 6.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Luxury 6-Bedroom Vacation Rental in Seaside, FloridaExperience Southern Comfort, a luxury six-bedroom vacation rental in Seaside, Florida, that accommodates up to 14 guests. Located on Venice Circle along Scenic Highway 30A, this distinctive three-story home combines elegant French-inspired design with the relaxed charm of a Seaside beach vacation. Enjoy a short walk to Seaside’s private beach access, town center, restaurants, boutique shopping, swimming pools, tennis courts, parks, playgrounds, farmers market, and Seaside Amphitheater. Ideal for family reunions, multigenerational vacations, holiday gatherings, and group getaways, Southern Comfort offers spacious living areas, private bedroom suites, and timeless European character.Six Bedrooms and Accommodations for 14 GuestsSouthern Comfort features four king bedrooms, one queen bedroom, and a family-friendly bunk room with a twin bunk bed and queen sleeper sofa. Five bedrooms have private ensuite bathrooms, offering added comfort and privacy for families and groups. The first-floor king suite includes a reading nook and private marble bathroom. The second-floor primary king suite features a furnished private porch, a marble bathroom with a soaking tub and separate walk-in shower, and generous closet space. A second king suite with custom closets, a built-in reading bench, and a private marble bathroom is also located on this floor. The third floor offers another king suite with a furnished porch, a queen bedroom with a private marble bathroom, and a bunk room with a TV and shared porch access. A convenient half bathroom is located nearby.Gourmet Kitchen and Elegant Gathering SpacesThe open-concept living area connects the family room, dining space, and fully equipped gourmet kitchen, creating an inviting place to gather after a day at the beach. French doors open onto a shaded porch surrounded by mature trees. The kitchen features an authentic six-burner AGA gas range, premium appliances, generous preparation space, and a large farmhouse dining table ideal for family meals and celebrations. Additional amenities include high-speed Wi-Fi, Smart TVs, a gas fireplace, full-size washer and dryer, an outdoor grilling area, and parking for up to three vehicles.French-Inspired Luxury in SeasideInspired by the villages of Provence, Southern Comfort features rich colors, eclectic furnishings, custom millwork, marble bathrooms, luxurious bedding, curated artwork, and distinctive architectural details. This elegant yet welcoming home offers a unique alternative to traditional beach houses, blending European sophistication with the laid-back coastal lifestyle of Seaside, Florida.Walk to Seaside Beach, Dining, and AttractionsEnjoy a convenient, walkable location near Seaside’s sugar-white sand beaches and emerald Gulf waters. Explore local restaurants, coffee shops, boutique stores, the farmers market, community pools, tennis courts, parks, and family-friendly events at the Seaside Amphitheater. With easy access to the best of Seaside and Scenic Highway 30A, Southern Comfort is an ideal choice for guests seeking a spacious luxury beach house close to shopping, dining, and coastal activities.Whether you are planning a family reunion, a multigenerational beach vacation, a holiday gathering, or a group getaway, Southern Comfort delivers the space, comfort, and distinctive design for a memorable stay in Seaside, Florida. Book this six-bedroom luxury vacation home and experience the charm of one of Florida’s most beloved coastal communities.* 5 night Summer, Spring & Spring Break; 3 night minimum for Fall; 2 night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURESFeatures 2,624 sq ft plus 3 large covered, furnished porches and 2 balconies5-minute, 352-yard walk to beach accessat Tupelo Pavilion largest private residential beaches on 30AFour king bedrooms, each bedroom has a private ensuite bathPrivate parking in rear private driveway for three carsThis home streams live TV through YouTubeTV, so you can catch local channels, sports, and favorite shows right from the smart TVsSteps away from the fitness centerClose to adult and family poolsWasher & Dryer on second floorAGA range in kitchenAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 Clay tennis & 3 Pickleball courts (ct. fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided2 parking passes are issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit.STR23-002010
